basicDetails.schemeName: Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana

children.text: Applicant must be registered with the State Social Security Board at least 90 days in advance.
Applicant must be in the age group of 18 to 60 years will be eligible for this scheme.
Applicant can be only received benefits at once.
If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, then he/she is not eligible for this scheme.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. Applicant must be registered with the State Social Security Board at least 90 days in advance.
1. Applicant must be in the age group of 18 to 60 years will be eligible for this scheme.
1. Applicant can be only received benefits at once. 
1. If applicant received from any other parallel scheme of the State Government, then he/she is not eligible for this scheme.

children.text: Medical aid of ₹50,000/- will be provided for the treatment of registered contract workers, Hamal workers and female domestic workers who are suffering from serious illness.
Serious diseases under the scheme will include kidney, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS and paralysis.

schemeContent.benefits_md:
1. Medical aid of ₹50,000/- will be provided for the treatment of registered contract workers, Hamal workers and female domestic workers who are suffering from serious illness.
1. Serious diseases under the scheme will include kidney, cancer, sickle cell anemia, heart disease, AIDS and paralysis.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 05 June 2018.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Theka Shramik, Hamaal Shramik Evan Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Gambhir Bimaari Chikitsa Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 05 June 2018.
